reason: I only hire people a mate or another local owner has used and vouched for, and nobody I know has heard of this guy. Pay-when-happy is decent, but I'm not handing my business's site to a stranger in Kuwait off an Instagram page.
objection: No UK clients, no reviews, one anonymous project and a demo for a made-up plumber. His own setup doesn't look established, so why would I trust him with mine, and who do I chase if it breaks at 11pm?
would_change_my_mind: Another owner I know in Manchester telling me he built their site and it's been fine for a few months.
